title: Local decoder for the toric code via signal exchange
summary: Local decoders provide a promising approach to real-time quantum error-correction by replacing centralized classical decoding, with significant hardware constraints, by a fully distributed architecture based on a simple, local update rule. We propose a new local decoder for Kitaev's toric code: the 2D signal-rule, that interprets odd parity stabilizer measurements as defects, attracted to each other via the exchange of binary signals. We present numerical evidence of exponential suppression of the logical error rate with system size below a threshold, under a phenomenological noise model…
